_description: Pure drawdown — no growth, no income, no tax. The simplest possible scenario.
_rationale: 500k savings, spending 15k/yr, 0% return. Linear drawdown: 500000/15000 = 33.3 years. Starts at age 55, runs out at age 88. Life expectancy 90. Fails every time → 0% probability.
name: Drawdown No Growth
